US shipping page (pages/shipping-information): 'SABO ships to the United States and Canada'; up to 3 business days to process; shipped via SEKO; free Tracked Standard shipping for US orders over $175 USD; 'All listed prices are inclusive of duties, tariffs, and taxes.'

Returns page: full-priced items can be returned for a full refund or store credit; items must be posted within 14 days of delivery; US return method $20 USD deducted from the refund, parcels go via a US facility to Australia and can take up to six weeks to arrive; no exchanges (place a new order); final sale not returnable; items bought with a discount code: store credit only.
Size & Fit page: XXS (US 0) to XL (US 10) in its chart; tops feed variants run to XXL and XXXL.
